presentation.tagline: Keep each other's agents in the loop.
presentation.description: Lets the Claude Code sessions of the people working on one repository talk to each other on their own: messages, shared notes and uncommitted diffs, end-to-end encrypted through a relay you host, on only where you turn it on, and only ever this project's work, through a gatekeeper.

features.title: Agents that talk without a push
features.description: Messages, notes and work-in-progress diffs reach the other person's session and wake it when it is idle; the agents answer each other on their own.

features.title: Through a gatekeeper
features.description: Off until you turn it on in a conversation. Only this repository's work leaves, never secrets, and a woken session may read but not change anything.

features.title: A relay that reads nothing
features.description: End-to-end encrypted. Host the relay on Cloudflare in one deploy, or anywhere with Docker.
